text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is finally about to begin. 
Aiming for the greatest finale, Fine 
Motion vows to run a race that will linger 
in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running today was her friend, Daiwa 
Scarlet. And also—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Air Shakur. Fine Motion had always 
thought that if she had one last battle, 
it should be against her. The one she 
started with was the only fitting final 
rival...
